mechanism_narrative: The sustained and accelerating decline observed across RETAIL_REC, TRANSIT, and WORKPLACES mobility, coupled with a sharp increase in RESIDENTIAL mobility, indicates a strong and ongoing societal shift towards reduced out-of-home activity that will continue to suppress retail and recreation over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If the mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than the mean RETAIL_REC over the last 28 days, despite the observed sustained declines in out-of-home mobility categories.

mechanism_narrative: The drastic drop in WORKPLACES mobility to -48.9% in the most recent week suggests widespread business closures or mandatory work-from-home policies, which will directly and severely suppress retail and recreation activity for the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES mobility remains below -40% from baseline for the next four weeks, but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: The simultaneous sharp decline in TRANSIT and PARKS mobility indicates a broad public avoidance of shared spaces and outdoor activities due to health concerns, which will compound the reduction in discretionary retail and recreation visits over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: If both TRANSIT and PARKS mobility remain significantly below baseline (e.g., below -30%) for the next two weeks, but RETAIL_REC shows a significant positive change.

failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL mobility remains above 20% and RETAIL_REC remains below -60%, but the mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days.

failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC remains below -60% from baseline for the next four weeks, but the mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days.
